commonCompleteVersionNote: No stable version is published for every published package. @openelement/router has only 0.41.0 prereleases, and @openelement/protocol and @openelement/compiler carry no stable release either; the 0.43.3 stable line covers element, create, and ui only. Any non-null value here must be present in every published package and is verified by release:registry-check. Schema v4 (#1557): packages awaiting their first publish carry status "unpublished" and no registry object; the alpha.11 release published all six packages, so no entry carries "unpublished" today.

latestPrerelease.note: The 1.0 prerelease line publishes onto latest (alpha.11 ruling), so the newest prerelease is served under latest for all six packages. The @alpha alias is NOT re-pointed at it: the Release workflow's OIDC trusted publishing cannot write dist-tags (E401), pending an owner manual `npm dist-tag add`. @alpha still resolves to 1.0.0-alpha.10 for element/router/create/ui, to 0.41.0-alpha.8 for protocol, and to nothing for compiler — the per-package registry blocks record those actual tags.
